description: Phase 9: remove the two legacy bearer secrets (spares4repairs/diag-orchestrator/bearer-token, spares4repairs/error-code-mcp/bearer-token) from AcDataStack. They were superseded by applianceclinic/production/{orchestrator,mcp}-bearer in 7.10c: no Lambda environment, CDK code or current config references them, no service principal read them in the last 30 days (CloudTrail), and their values are refused (401) by the orchestrator and the MCP. Every AC resource is DeletionPolicy Retain, so this removal deletes nothing; step 2 of the runbook schedules the deletion of the then-unmanaged secrets with the 7-day recovery window. No other secret changes.
grantNotes: None: removing a DeletionPolicy Retain resource from the stack makes no call to the resource's service.
